title: Trump says ex-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s affair with an alleged Chinese spy did not threaten national security
lede: President Trump said Jensen Huang's affair with former Megaspeed executive Alice Huang did not put US security at risk, and doubted she is a spy, against the findings of US officials.

points: A memo produced under Secretary of State Marco Rubio reportedly named Alice Huang as working for China's Ministry of State Security.
Trump was reportedly briefed on it at least twice, once in May before Huang joined him on a China trip; he says he did not know.
The US and Singapore were investigating Megaspeed for smuggling Nvidia chips into China before the affair became public.
Huang left Nvidia after 33 years, following further reports of affairs with two employees.
Trump called a return for Huang not a bad idea, after Elon Musk, Garry Tan and Tim Sweeney signed a letter backing one.
